# `aitbc blockchain sync-status`

Show synchronization status per chain and connected node.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc blockchain sync-status [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--node-url` | text | `http://127.0.0.1:8202` | no | Local node RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |
| `--all-chains` | flag | `false` | no | Show status for all supported chains (default: node's configured chains) |
| `--chain-id` | text | — | no | Show status for a specific chain only |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc blockchain sync-status
```
